bearerAuth.description: Bearer Authentication scheme. To use this authentication method indicate Authorization: Bearer <JWT> in the header. Please replace the value of <JWT> with the JWT generated for that user. Example Authorization: Bearer eyJ0eX... (please note that for security reasons the JWT in this example is limited to 6 characters)

ApiKeyAuth.description: API Key Authentication scheme. To use this authentication method indicate Authorization: Basic <UserUUID:APIKEY> in the header. Please replace the value of <UserUUID> with the internal Verifone user ID for that user and <APIKEY> with the apikey issued for that user and encode the whole string in base64. Example f8811dd2-3667-4a1e-be8b-b42b63743254:ABCheDEFBXUGHIDmVPPPFOLtLoEnWYJVHdZF results in a base64 string of Zjg4MTFkZDItMzY2Ny00YTFlLWJlOGItYjQyYjYzNzQzMjU0OkFCQ2hlREVGQlhVR0hJRG1WUFBQRk9MdExvRW5XWUpWSGRaRg== This results in the following string to be used in the header: Authorization: Basic Zjg4MTFkZDItMzY2Ny00YTFlLWJlOGItYjQyYjYzNzQzMjU0OkFCQ2hlREVGQlhVR0hJRG1WUFBQRk9MdExvRW5XWUpWSGRaRg==,

totals.description: Total number of reports. The total number of reports matching the search criteria, which can be larger than the number of elements in the array "reports" (which is upper bound by the "pageSize" parameter from the query request).

createdOn.description: The date and time the report was created.

modifiedOn.description: The date and time the report was last modified.

reportEntityUid.description: The internally assigned identifier for the entity for which the report was generated.

fileName.description:
The filename of the report including extenstion (e.g. myfile.txt).
Please note that the file extenstion is validated based on the mimeType indicated in the request and
that the reportUid is concatenated to the filename (format: filename_reportUid.ext, e.g. myfile_cb941e2d-f446-413a-8c2b-28e26eb048fc.txt)

ReportTypeEnum.title: Report type enumeration
ReportTypeEnum.description:
The type of the report. |Value|Description| |--------|-----------| |ABS_SETTLEMENT_RESPONSE_REPORT|ABS settlement report (generated and returned by ABS during settlement as a ready-made file report)| |BBX_PARTNER_COMMISSION_REPORT|BBX commission report (generated by BBX as a ready-made file report)| |INTERCARD_COMMISSION_REPORT|InterCard commission report (generated by InterCard as a ready-made file report)| |DAILY_TRANSACTION_REPORT|The daily transactions report is generated for each payout to the clearing entity (which e.g. can be either a store, a merchant or even a franchisee level). The content therefore depends on the particular setup.
Please see https://verifone.cloud/docs/in-store-payments/merchant-payout-reports#daily-transactions-report| |INTERCARD_INVOICE|InterCard invoice (generated by InterCard as a ready-made file report)| |MERCHANT_SETTLEMENT_REPORT|The merchant settlement report contains a total summary (TS) and summary (S) records for all payment types which contributed to a single payout to the merchant.
Please see https://verifone.cloud/docs/in-store-payments/merchant-payout-reports#merchant-settlement-report|

ReportParameters.title: Report Parameters

batchUUID.description: The unique identifier of the settlement batch this report is related to. Mapped to PDSP's `transaction.context.paymentContext.batchUUID`.

settlementBatchFileNumber.description: The identifier of the settlement batch file this report is related to. Mapped to PDSP's `transaction.settlementContext.settlementBatchFileNumber`.

generatedOn.description: The timestamp when the original report was created.

invoicePeriodFrom.description: The start date of the invoicing period.

invoicePeriodTo.description: The end date of the invoicing period.

reportableDay.description: The date the report was generated for.

ReportParameters.description: List of parameters which were basis for the generation of this report.

get.summary: Get the list of all reports
get.description: By passing in the appropriate options, you can search for reports in the system.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description:
The ordering sequence of the selected records.
If this parameter is not provided, descending order will be chosen.

|Value|Description|
|--------|-----------|
|ASC|Ascending order|
|DESC| Descending order|

parameters.name: orderCriteria
parameters.description: The ordering criteria of the selected records. If this parameter not provided, the result will be ordered by createdOn. |Value|Description| |--------|-----------| |createdOn|Date & Time| |modifiedOn| Date & Time| |status| Report status| |mimeType| Mime type| |reportType| Report type| |reportUid| Report identifier|

parameters.name: search
